name: Fourteen Out
summary: Single-player solitaire where you remove pairs summing to fourteen to clear the tableau.
rules_text: Shuffle a standard 52-card deck and deal twelve face-up tableau piles: the first four piles get five cards each, the remaining eight get four cards each, using the whole deck. Only the top card of each pile is playable; cards beneath are blocked until exposed. Empty piles are never refilled. On your turn remove one valid pair whose values sum to fourteen and place it in the foundation. Valid pairs are Ace-King, 2-Queen, 3-Jack, 4-10, 5-9, 6-8, and 7-7; suits do not matter. Removal uncovers the next card in that pile, which becomes playable. Continue removing pairs. You win if all twelve piles are emptied to the foundation; you lose if no summing-to-fourteen pair is available among current top cards.
rating_reason: Specific solitaire but single-player and mostly luck
